'''Barley''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|barley flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|barley ''wine'']] – a curious exception to the otherwise universal classification of such cereal grain-derived beverages as ''beer''.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] barley for its ''wine''.
